serviceDescription:
Welcome to Prescient Security, a renowned leader in multi-framework compliance audits and security assessments, trusted by over 3,000 SaaS and PaaS clients worldwide for the following reasons:

We have deep expertise in offensive security assessments and risk-based scoping of high-quality controls that meet your business and regulatory risks and constraints.
Our unwavering commitment to independent, competent, quality evaluation is paired with frictionless customer service to ensure our assessments add significant efficiencies to your cybersecurity program in the long run. We focus on clear and concise communication throughout the engagement. 
We pride ourselves on partnerships with the leading compliance automation platforms like Vanta and others. which enhances our service offerings with cutting-edge technologies and streamlined evidence collection process, saving our clients a significant amount of time and manual efforts.
Startups and scale ups can access our services at an affordable cost.
We are a CREST Certified Penetration Tester, a testament to our capability in delivering thorough and reliable penetration testing services.

Prescient Security's 3PAO Assessment Support Services:
      •     FedRAMP Gap Assessment: Identifying and addressing compliance gaps for FedRAMP authorization.
      •     FedRAMP Readiness Assessment: Preparing your organization for the FedRAMP assessment process.
      •     FedRAMP Full/Initial Assessment: Comprehensive evaluation against all FedRAMP criteria.
      •     FedRAMP Annual Assessment: Ensuring continuous compliance through regular assessments.
      •     FedRAMP Significant Change Assessment: Assessing the impact of major changes on your FedRAMP status.
      •     FedRAMP Red Team Exercises: Simulated cyber-attacks to test and strengthen defenses.
      •     FedRAMP Continuous Monitoring Support: Ongoing assessment and support for sustained compliance.

Join the ranks of our satisfied SaaS clients and benefit from our partnerships, certifications, and seasoned expertise.
Discover our services on the FedRAMP Marketplace and take the first step towards secure, compliant, and dynamic cybersecurity operations.
